## Purpose and Executables
This monorepo delivers Kubernetes autoscaling controllers, primarily:
- **Cluster Autoscaler (CA):** changes cluster node capacity for pending workloads and removes unneeded nodes. Entry point: `cluster-autoscaler/main.go`.
- **Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA):** recommends and applies pod CPU/memory request changes through three cooperating binaries: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/main.go`, `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/main.go`, and `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/main.go`.
- Smaller independent components include the deployment-sizing nanny at `addon-resizer/main.go` and a Balancer custom controller at `balancer/main.go`.

All primary implementations are Go programs, intended to run in Kubernetes as containerized controllers.

## Cluster Autoscaler Control Loop
CA starts from `cluster-autoscaler/main.go`, reads Kubernetes cluster state, evaluates scheduling/capacity conditions, and issues node-group size changes through a selected provider implementation. Its deployment boundary is the Kubernetes API on one side and a cloud/provider control plane on the other.

Provider selection is centralized by the cloud-provider router:
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/router/router_all.go`
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/router/router_aws.go`
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/router/router_gce.go`

Concrete providers encapsulate cloud-specific node-group discovery, instance templates, caching, and scale operations, e.g.:
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/aws/aws_cloud_provider.go`
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/azure/azure_cloud_provider.go`
- `cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/oci/nodepools/oci_cloud_provider.go`

This adapter boundary supports many public clouds plus Cluster API and an external gRPC provider.

## VPA Recommendation Pipeline
The recommender continuously builds a model of targeted workloads, their resource usage, and OOM signals; computes recommendations; then persists them to VPA API objects/checkpoints.

Key stages:
- Cluster workload/VPA ingestion: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/input/cluster_feeder.go`
- Metrics and historical inputs: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/input/metrics/metrics_source.go`, `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/input/history/history_provider.go`
- Stateful resource model and aggregation: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/model/cluster.go`, `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/model/aggregate_container_state.go`
- Estimation and recommendation construction: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/logic/estimator.go`, `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/logic/recommender.go`
- Periodic reconciliation/post-processing: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/recommender_controller.go`, `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/routines/capping_post_processor.go`
- Checkpoint persistence: `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/recommender/checkpoint/checkpoint_writer.go`

The Kubernetes API is the durable coordination surface: VPA resources hold desired policy and recommendation status; checkpoint resources retain recommender state.

## VPA Admission and Actuation
The admission controller intercepts Pod and VPA admission requests. It validates VPA objects, matches Pods to VPAs, obtains current recommendations, and returns resource patches before Pods are created:
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/logic/server.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/resource/pod/handler.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/admission-controller/resource/pod/patch/calculator.go`

The updater handles already-running Pods. It selects eligible Pods, applies in-place resource updates where supported or evicts Pods for recreation, while enforcing eviction and update restrictions:
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/logic/updater.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/inplace/resource_updates.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/updater/restriction/pods_restriction_factory.go`

Thus, recommendation production is separated from admission-time mutation and runtime actuation.

## APIs, Deployment, and Observability
VPA defines versioned Kubernetes CRD types and generated clients/informers:
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/apis/autoscaling.k8s.io/v1/types.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/clientset.go`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`

Helm charts deploy controller workloads, RBAC, CRDs, webhook configuration, services, and optional monitoring:
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/charts/vertical-pod-autoscaler/templates/admission-controller-webhook.yaml`
- `vertical-pod-autoscaler/charts/vertical-pod-autoscaler/templates/recommender-deployment.yaml`
- `cluster-autoscaler/charts/cluster-autoscaler/templates/deployment.yaml`

Metrics endpoints and Prometheus integration are represented by VPA metrics packages and CA/VPA chart ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule templates.

## Secondary Controllers
Addon Resizer is a simpler Kubernetes controller that estimates deployment resource needs from cluster/node counts and updates a target workload:
- `addon-resizer/main.go`
- `addon-resizer/nanny/nanny_lib.go`
- `addon-resizer/nanny/estimator.go`

Balancer is a separate CRD-backed controller for balancing/scaling behavior using priority or proportional policies:
- `balancer/pkg/apis/balancer.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1/types.go`
- `balancer/pkg/controller/controller.go`
- `balancer/pkg/policy/priority.go`
